================================================================================
  Mantra MFS100 Native Windows Hello Fingerprint Setup Guide
================================================================================

PREREQUISITES:
1. Mantra MFS100 USB Fingerprint Scanner plugged in.
2. Official Mantra MFS100 Driver v9.0.2.5 installed.
   (Verify red LED blinks when connected).
3. Windows 11 (64-bit) or Windows 10 (64-bit).
4. A Windows Hello PIN already set up on your user account.
   (Windows Hello requires a PIN before allowing fingerprint setup).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
QUICK START (3 STEPS):
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

STEP 1: Enable Test Signing (Required for self-signed driver)
   1. Open Command Prompt or PowerShell as Administrator.
   2. Run:
        bcdedit /set testsigning on
   3. Restart your computer.
   (Note: For commercial production, sign the adapter DLLs with a DigiCert/Sectigo
    code-signing certificate to run in standard mode without Test Signing).

STEP 2: Register Windows Biometric Framework (WBF) Adapters
   1. Extract this ZIP to a permanent folder (e.g., C:\MantraWBF).
   2. Right-click "7_Register_WBF_Windows_Hello.bat" and select "Run as administrator".
   3. The script will automatically:
      - Install the driver certificate into Trusted Root and Trusted Publishers.
      - Install and start the MFS100 Bridge Service in the background.
      - Copy 64-bit Sensor & Engine adapters to C:\Windows\System32\WinBioPlugIns.
      - Register the biometric database configuration in the Windows Registry.
      - Restart the Windows Biometric Service (WbioSrvc).
   4. Verify you see "[SUCCESS] Mantra MFS100 registered with Windows Biometric Framework!"

STEP 3: Enroll Fingerprint in Windows Settings
   1. Open Windows Settings (Win + I) -> Accounts -> Sign-in options.
   2. Click "Fingerprint recognition (Windows Hello)" -> "Set up" -> "Get started".
   3. Enter your Windows Hello PIN when prompted.
   4. Place and lift your finger on the Mantra MFS100 scanner when the sensor LED lights up.
   5. Once enrollment completes, press Win + L to lock your PC.
   6. Touch the scanner with your enrolled finger to unlock Windows natively!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TROUBLESHOOTING & LOGS:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- View Real-Time Logs:
  Run "show_logs.bat" as Administrator to see live WBF adapter and Bridge Service logs.

- Uninstallation:
  Right-click "8_Unregister_WBF_Windows_Hello.bat" and select "Run as administrator".
================================================================================
